title: Targeting Osteoporosis-Osteoarthritis Comorbidity: Multi-Omics Identification of SON and Exploration of Therapeutic Agents.
authors: Jiang, Kunlong; Du, Jun; Yang, Peng; Lin, Liyun; Liu, Jiachen; Qiao, Yusen; Yang, Huilin; Geng, Dechun; Li, Kun
one_liner_zh: 该研究通过多组学与虚拟筛选探索骨质疏松-骨关节炎共病中的SON蛋白及药物靶点，虽涉及分子对接但非蛋白质-DNA互作体系，且无TF-DNA结合建模或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题关联较弱。
abstract: Osteoporosis (OP) and osteoarthritis (OA) frequently coexist in the elderly, yet shared molecular pathways remain unclear. We employed weighted gene co-expression network analysis (WGCNA), independent cohort differential verification, and integration of multiple datasets to explore the association between the two diseases and identify the hub genes. Then, through Mendelian randomization and single-cell sequencing methods, we confirmed that SON might be the key protein linking these two diseases and a promising therapeutic target for comorbidity. Additionally, this study utilized the FDA drug database for virtual screening to evaluate the potential of SON protein as a drug target. Nilotinib, with a high docking score, was listed as a candidate drug. Overall, our findings suggest that SON may play a protective role in the comorbidity of OP and OA, but further functional studies are required to confirm its causal role. Moreover, Nilotinib shows inhibitory effects on osteoclast differentiation and targets SON in vitro, indicating its potential as a candidate drug for further investigation.
abstract_zh: 骨质疏松症（OP）和骨关节炎（OA）在老年人中常共存，但共享的分子通路仍不清楚。我们采用加权基因共表达网络分析（WGCNA）、独立队列差异验证以及多数据集整合，探讨这两种疾病之间的关联并识别核心基因。随后，通过孟德尔随机化和单细胞测序方法，我们确认SON可能是连接这两种疾病的关键蛋白，并作为合并症的有前景治疗靶点。此外，本研究利用FDA药物数据库进行虚拟筛选，以评估SON蛋白作为药物靶点的潜力。尼洛替尼（Nilotinib）具有高对接分数，被列为候选药物。总体而言，我们的发现表明SON可能在OP和OA合并症中发挥保护作用，但需要进一步的功能研究来确认其因果作用。此外，尼洛替尼在体外对破骨细胞分化具有抑制作用并靶向SON，表明其作为候选药物具有进一步研究的潜力。
